thread_title: Pulling Priority Help

content:
Hello there and welcome aboard <:Saya_yum:1513124263291387975> 

First off : did you find Cheri's handbook ? ( just type /new if you didn't )

About pure cores : you'll eventually want 5 teams ( 19 awakeners minimum ) so you can really indulge in all realms as much as you want. Just remember to grab some wheels as well.

And no, Mouchette beyond E2 is not that relevant *until* you have your 5 teams ready
thread_title: Pulling Priority Help

content:
As for limited banners : all awakeners currently displayed and those coming in tomorrow are great ( although Pontos is more niche in my opinion ).
So unless you aim for a max-optimized team I'd say pull 1 copy for any that catches your eye / synergies with your teams ( you can get 1 extra proto dupe from the store each month ).
You can see how much you like them in hectic train by borrowing from a whale

content:
I'd say, depends on your linup.
Reminder : adding a chaos awakener to your team do *not* negate the pure realm bonus and actually adds an extra boon.
( Except GLot. She's a lovely weirdo u.u )

Aurita can fit in a team that has either discard/draw or high-cost skills.

Sanga is great in a shield-based team but she's pretty versatile, really. Still needs a healer though.
